notes.title: Horror Simulator VR Full Version Release Date
notes.notes:
The ultimate nightmare begins! Horror Simulator VR has officially launched on Steam, plunging you into a world of relentless terror, strategic survival, and heart-pounding encounters. Will you outsmart the demons… or become their next victim?

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]
🛠️ LOBBY OVERHAUL

Revamped Lobby: Now with a Soul Shop and a Basement crawling with secrets!

🛍️ Soul Shop: Trade Soul Coins for avatars, cosmetics, and decorations. Try before you buy in the new Dressing Room!

🔮 Basement Secrets: Unearth game-breaking items like Decoy Grenades, Night Vision Goggles, and the terrifying Mimic Pill!

😈 DEMON SYSTEM EXPANSION

10 New Demons: Face Astaroth, Sitri, Halphas, and more. Each brings unique horrors:

🗡️ Shax: Silence your teammates during hunts.

🧠 Allocer: Sanity drains slower… until you get too close.

🗺️ STRATEGY UPGRADES

Demon Tracking Rules: From "Easy" (track from start) to Insanity Mode (NO tracking!).

🎒 Backpack System: Carry 4 items now—grab tools directly from your back!

[h2]Survival Essentials[/h2]
🔥 Wishlist & Play Now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3063780/Horror_Simulator_VR_COOP]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3063780/Horror_Simulator_VR_COOP[/url]
🎮 Join the Horror Horde: Team up with 20,000+ survivors on Discord for strategies, screams, and spoilers: [url=https://discord.gg/hsvr]https://discord.gg/hsvr[/url]


Why Play?

3 Maps: Explore abandoned mansions, cursed forests, and derelict hospitals.

Dozens of Power-Ups: Outwit demons with Speedy Lollipops, Voice Changers, and more.

Unscripted Terror: Every playthrough is a fresh nightmare.

Ready to test your sanity?
- The Horror Simulator VR Team

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 2025.2.14
notes.notes:
[h1]🎮 Horror Simulator Version Update Notes 🎮[/h1]
[h3] What's New:[/h3]
🎭 Avatar masks are now purchasable with Soul Coins! Gold coins can only be used to buy items.
🗓️ Added Weekly and Daily Quests! Complete weekly quests to earn Soul Coins and daily quests for gold coins.
� New In-Game Challenges that refresh randomly each round – earn extra gold coins!
👜 Introduced the Armbank, a new way to store items on your arm, replacing the old bubble system.
✋ Long-distance grabbing now has two modes: Finger and Palm. Choose your preference in the settings!
🔄 Added an option to disable the joystick during rotation.
[h3] Bug Fixes:[/h3]
� Fixed a bug where hunting speed could randomly slow down.
🦾 Fixed an issue where arms could sometimes stretch unnaturally.
🕳️ Fixed a bug causing players to occasionally fall through the ground.
🎮 Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the game flow upon entering.
🔔 Fixed an issue where the Summoning Bell wouldn’t disappear after use.
🛗 Fixed a mismatch between the number of elevator ready-state lights and actual players.
🦖 Fixed a bug where switching to the Dinosaur Avatar wouldn’t save properly.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where elevator lights didn’t turn on correctly in the tutorial.
💡 Resolved flickering issues with certain objects when illuminated by headlamps in dark environments.
[h3] Optimizations:[/h3]
🎲 Adjusted the trigger probability for The Grasp.
👵 Optimized the wandering paths of the Grandma’s minions in Insanity Mode.
😈 Demon Behavior Improvements:
- Aini: Players lose sanity faster when Aini is nearby.
- Foras: Occasionally tracks locked players and prioritizes them during hunts.
- Buer: More likely to hunt when hearing players, but calmer when not.
- Ose: Stays visible longer during hunts.
- Paimon: Increased throwing force for objects.

Get ready for a spookier and smoother experience! 👻🎉
JOIN OUR DISCORD FOR EVENT AND GIVEAWAYS! [url=https://discord.gg/hsvr]https://discord.gg/hsvr[/url]
